Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas. Image 1 is the VISUAL STYLE ONLY: use this richer soft-edged coarse-pixel rendering, dimensional fur and cloth shading, expressive small faces, anatomically shaped heads and shoulders. Do NOT copy any reference hero's costume or equipment. These are civilian townspeople, with simple tunics, dark trousers and boots. Preserve each species and listed main colours but give each a modestly individual face, hair/fleece, collar or sleeve shape. Do not use rectangular block placeholder bodies or perfectly flat faces. Match soft coloured selective contours and MATTE storybook shading; no thick black outline, no white rim, no surrounding aura or haze. Not high-resolution painted illustration. Keep to coarse pixel clusters readable at 48px gameplay size.
THREE COLUMNS and SEVEN ROWS, all 21 full-body sprites. Row is a distinct NPC; columns idle, walk A, walk B. All heads/torso NEUTRAL FRONT FACING with both eyes visible, fixed head and torso height. Only alternate lower legs for gentle walking. Must work moving any direction. NO directional pose, no whole body hopping, no scenery, no labels, no ground shadows. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with generous gutters; no background colours or backlighting.
